## brute_force('aabbb') -- the fixed scan

Every window the scan looks at, with the frequency table at that moment.
The 'balanced <--' rows are the windows that count.

| start | end | window seen | counts  | distinct | verdict           | best |
+-------+-----+-------------+---------+----------+-------------------+------+
|     0 |   0 | a           | a:1     |        1 | needs two letters |    0 |
|     0 |   1 | aa          | a:2     |        1 | needs two letters |    0 |
|     0 |   2 | aab         | a:2 b:1 |        2 | counts differ     |    0 |
|     0 |   3 | aabb        | a:2 b:2 |        2 | balanced <--      |    4 |
|     0 |   4 | aabbb       | a:2 b:3 |        2 | counts differ     |    4 |
|     1 |   1 | a           | a:1     |        1 | needs two letters |    4 |
|     1 |   2 | ab          | a:1 b:1 |        2 | balanced <--      |    4 |
|     1 |   3 | abb         | a:1 b:2 |        2 | counts differ     |    4 |
|     1 |   4 | abbb        | a:1 b:3 |        2 | counts differ     |    4 |
|     2 |   2 | b           | b:1     |        1 | needs two letters |    4 |
|     2 |   3 | bb          | b:2     |        1 | needs two letters |    4 |
|     2 |   4 | bbb         | b:3     |        1 | needs two letters |    4 |
|     3 |   3 | b           | b:1     |        1 | needs two letters |    4 |
|     3 |   4 | bb          | b:2     |        1 | needs two letters |    4 |
|     4 |   4 | b           | b:1     |        1 | needs two letters |    4 |
